title: Efficient generation of locus-specific human CAR-T cells with CRISPR/cCas12a
protocol: Remove E. coli BL21(DE3) competent cells from a −80°C freezer and thaw on ice.
Mix pET22B-Cas12a-mutant plasmid (1 μL, ∼100 ng) and pUltra-CNF plasmid (1 μL, ∼100 ng) into the cells.
Incubate the Eppendorf tube on ice for 30 min.
Heat the tube at 42°C for 45 s in a water bath kettle.
Place the tube on ice for 5 min without shaking.
Add 1 mL of 2YT medium to the tube and incubate at 37°C in a shaking incubator (220 rpm) for 1 h.
Centrifuge at 5,000 × g for 3 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the cells with 100 μL of 2YT medium.
Plate the suspension on a LB plate containing antibiotics (50 μg/mL spectinomycin and 100 μg/mL ampicillin).
Incubate the LB plate at 37°C in a constant-temperature incubator for 12–16 h.
Pick a single colony and suspend it in 15 mL of 2YT medium containing antibiotics (50 μg/mL spectinomycin and 100 μg/mL ampicillin) for culture.
Take 10 mL of overnight culture and dilute it with 1 L of 2YT expression medium containing antibiotics (50 μg/mL spectinomycin and 100 μg/mL ampicillin).
Incubate the diluted culture at 37°C and 220 rpm until OD600 reaches 0.3.
Add unnatural amino acid AeF to the culture at a final concentration of 1 mM.
Grow the culture at 37°C until OD600 reaches 0.6–0.8.
Cool the culture at 4°C for 15 min, and add isopropyl β-d-1-thiogalactopyranoside at a final concentration of 0.2 mM.
Maintain the culture at 18°C and 220 rpm in a shaker incubator for 16 h to express Cas12a protein.
Harvest cells by centrifugation at 5,000 × g for 15 min at 4°C.
Discard supernatant, and resuspend cells in 100 mL of lysis buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl [pH 8.0], 1 M KCl, 10 mM imidazole) containing 1 mM phenylmethylsulfonyl fluoride to prevent protein degradation.
Sonicate the suspension (30% power 5 s on and 5 s off) on ice for 20 min.
Centrifuge the lysate at 18,000 × g for 20–30 min at 4°C to pellet the cellular debris.
Balance a Ni-NTA resin gravity column with lysis buffer.
Load the supernatant on the column and allow it to flow under the influence of gravity.
Repeat the loading step two additional times.
Wash the resin with 5–10 column volumes of wash buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl [pH 8.0], 1 M KCl, 20 mM imidazole).
Elute the protein from the column with 10–20 mL of elution buffer (50 mM Tris-HCl [pH 8.0], 1 M KCl, 250 mM imidazole).
Transfer the eluted protein to an Amicon Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Unit 50K.
Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm for 20 min to concentrate the eluate to a volume of <1 mL.
Add 14 mL of PBS to the filter unit and centrifuge at 4,000 rpm for 20 min to change the buffer.
Repeat the step one more time to change the buffer again.
Balance an ÄKTA pure protein purification system (Cytiva) and the Superdex® 200 Increase 10/300 GL column with PBS at 0.5 mL/min.
Wash the injection loop with PBS buffer.
Inject the concentrated sample into the loop.
Continue to wash the column with PBS and collect peaks according to the absorption of A280nm.
Concentrate collected fractions using an Amicon® Ultra-15 Centrifugal Filter Unit 50K, as described in step 3g.
Determine the purity of the Cas12a protein by means of 8% SDS-polyacrylamide gel electrophoresis.
Determine its concentration by means of UV–vis spectroscopy (NanoDrop One Microvolume UV–vis spectrophotometer).
Filter the concentrated AzCas12a protein with a 0.22 μm filter.
Aliquot the filtered protein.
Store the aliquots at −80°C.
Trypsinize and resuspend AAV293 packaging cells from four 15-cm dishes.
Culture the cells at 37°C in complete medium: Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium with 4.5 g/L glucose, sodium pyruvate, l-glutamine, 25 mM HEPES, and 10% fetal bovine serum (PAN-Biotech).
Aspirate the medium and add 6 mL of prewarmed PBS.
Aspirate the PBS and add 2 mL of trypsin-EDTA (0.25%) containing phenol red.
Hold for 1 min at room temperature (∼25°C).
Add 10 mL of prewarmed complete medium to stop digestion.
Seed fifteen 10-cm tissue culture dishes with cells at a density of 1 × 10^7 cells per dish the day before transfection.
Transfect each 10-cm dish with 5 μg of pAAV CD19-CAR, 5 μg of pHelper plasmid, and 5 μg of AAV-RC6 serotype plasmid along with polyethyleneimine (PEI) at a 3:1 PEI/plasmid mass ratio.
Mix the plasmids with Opti-MEM to a total volume of 250 μL for each dish.
Mix 45 μL of 1 mg/mL PEI with 205 μL of Opti-MEM separately.
Incubate both mixtures at room temperature (∼25°C) for 5 min.
Combine the plasmid-Opti-MEM mixture and the PEI-Opti-MEM mixture after incubation.
Incubate the combined mixture at room temperature (∼25°C) for 20–30 min.
Add the transfection mixture to each dish.
Wash cells with prewarmed PBS 24 hours post-transfection.
Culture cells in fresh complete medium after washing.
Suspend untrypsinized cells with medium supernatant seventy-two hours post-transfection.
Transfer cell suspension from fifteen 10-cm dishes into a 50-mL centrifuge tube, collecting a total of 15 mL.
Centrifuge the tubes at 500 × g for 10 min to collect transfected cells.
Resuspend collected cells with 1 mL PBS per dish (total 15 mL).
Mix 1.5 mL chloroform with the 15 mL cell suspension.
Incubate the mixture at 37°C with shaking for 1 hour.
Add NaCl to a final concentration of 1 M in the mixture.
Centrifuge the tube at 20,000 × g at 4°C for 15 min.
Transfer the aqueous layer to another 50-mL centrifuge tube.
Discard the chloroform layer.
Add PEG8000 to the aqueous layer at 10% (w/v).
Incubate the mixture at 4°C for 1 hour.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g at 4°C for 15 minutes.
Discard the supernatant.
Resuspend the pellet in 5 mL of PBS buffer.
Incubate at room temperature (∼25°C) for 10 minutes.
Add 1 μL of Benzonase nuclease to the solution.
Incubate at 37°C for 30 minutes.
Add 5 mL 1:1 (v/v) of chloroform to the solution.
Shake the tube up and down a few times.
Centrifuge at 20,000 × g at 4°C for 20 minutes.
Transfer the aqueous layer to an Amicon® Ultra-4 Centrifugal Filter Unit 100K.
Centrifuge at 4,000 rpm for 10 minutes.
Aliquot the AAV and store the aliquots at −80°C.
Mix 10 μL of 5 mM EDTA into the working solution.
Incubate the mixture at 65°C for 10 min to inactivate the DNase I.
Make 6 serial dilutions of standard curve plasmid.
Dilute DNase I-treated AAV samples according to the dilution scheme provided.
Set up and load a 96-well plate using Bestar SYBR Green qPCR Mastermix.
Perform PCR according to the manufacturer’s instructions for Bestar SYBR Green qPCR Mastermix.
Use primers ITR-FW: 5′-GGAACCCCTAGTGATGGAGTT and ITR-RV: 5′-CGGCCTCAGTGAGCGA for qPCR.
Analyze data using QuantStudio software.
Determine the physical titer of samples based on the standard curve and sample dilutions.
Isolate PBMCs from healthy donors using Ficoll-Paque PLUS according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Count isolated cells with a CellDrop Automated Cell Counter or a blood counting chamber.
Transfer fewer than 5 × 10^7 but more than 5 × 10^6 cells to a 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge the tube at 90 × g for 10 min.
Resuspend the cells with T cell isolation buffer (PBS without Ca2+ and Mg2+, containing 0.1% BSA and 2 mM EDTA) for isolation of primary T cells.
Isolate T cells with a Dynabeads™ Untouched™ Human T Cells Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Count primary T cells with a CellDrop Automated Cell Counter.
Centrifuge the tube containing collected T cells at 200 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant after centrifugation.
Wash cells once with 4 mL of PBS.
Centrifuge the cells at 200 × g for 5 min.
Discard the PBS after centrifugation.
Resuspend the cells with complete medium to a density of 0.5–1 × 10^6 cells/mL.
Culture T cells at 37°C with 5% CO2 in T cell complete medium.
Transfer the XYbeads Human CD3/CD28 T Cell Activator to a 1.5-mL Eppendorf tube.
Place the tube on a DynaMag-5 Magnet for 1 minute.
Aspirate the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Remove the tube from the magnet and add 1 mL of T cell complete medium to resuspend the beads.
Place the tube back on the magnet for 1 minute.
Aspirate the supernatant again.
Repeat steps 9c through 9e three times.
Activate the T cells with XYbeads Human CD3/CD28 T Cell Activator at a 1:1 ratio.
Culture the cells at 37°C under 5% CO2.
Mix 30 pmol of AzCas12a with 36 pmol Dibenzocyclooctyne (DBCO) modified crRNA in sterile tubes.
Add 1× PBS to each tube to bring the total volume to 4 μL.
Incubate the resulting RNP complex at 25°C for 5 minutes.
Shake the mixture at 4°C for 3 hours before electroporation.
Suspend and collect T cells in 15-mL centrifuge tubes.
Remove XYbeads Human CD3/CD28 T Cell Activator with a DynaMag™-5 Magnet.
Count the cells with a CellDrop Automated Cell Counter.
Place 1.5 × 10^6 cells per reaction into a new 15-mL centrifuge tube.
Centrifuge at 200 × g for 3 min.
Wash cells once with 4 mL of PBS.
Aspirate as much supernatant as possible with a p200 tip.
Resuspend cells in electroporation buffer (Celetrix 13-0104) at 20 μL per reaction.
Mix 20 μL of cell suspension and RNP complex well with a p200 pipette.
Transfer the mixture to a 20-μL electroporation tube with a 1–200 μL pipette tip for electroporation.
Electroporate using a Celetrix CTX-1500A LE electroporator at 420 V for 20 ms at one pulse.
Transfer the cells to a tube containing 100 μL of 37°C prewarmed complete medium.
Pipette 30 μL of electroporated cells into a well of a 48-well plate for culture.
Add AAV to the T cells at multiplicity of infection = 1 × 10^6 (∼5–6 μL AAV stock solution).
Shake well.
Count cells every day during culture.
Passage cells to a density of 5 × 10^5 cells/mL when the cell density exceeds 1 × 10^6 cells/mL, usually 2 days after transduction.
Transfer cells from a 48-well plate (300 μL) to a 24-well plate (500 μL) two days post-electroporation.
Culture transferred cells in complete medium for further expansion.
Transfer cells from the 24-well plate to a 12-well plate four days after electroporation and culture in 1 mL of complete medium.
Evaluate CAR-T cell preparation efficiency by flow cytometry five days after electroporation.
Assess immunological characteristics of CAR-T cells using LDH-Glo™ Cytotoxicity Assay and ELISA.
Collect 1 × 10^6 CAR-T cells in a 1.5-mL Eppendorf tube.
Centrifuge at 400 × g for 5 min.
Discard the supernatant.
Wash the cells once with 200 μL of PBS.
Resuspend the cells in 1 mL of blocking buffer (PBS containing 1% fetal bovine serum).
Incubate them for 1 h at 4°C for blocking.
Resuspend the blocked cells in 100 μL of blocking buffer and 1 μL of c-Myc mouse monoclonal antibodies (Invitrogen).
Incubate the cells at 4°C for 1 h.
Centrifuge and wash the cells twice with 200 μL of PBS to remove as much of the primary antibodies as possible.
Dilute antimouse IgG (H+L), F(ab')2 Fragment (Alexa Fluor® 647 Conjugate, Cell Signaling Technology) in PBS at a 1:1000 ratio.
Resuspend the cells in the dilutions and incubate at 4°C for 30 min.
Centrifuge and wash the resulting anti-Myc-antibody-stained cells twice with 200 μL of PBS.
Resuspend the stained cells with 200 μL of PBS.
Analyze the suspension on a CytoFlex flow cytometer (Beckman).
Gates are set based on forward scatter area (FSC-A) and side scatter area (SSC-A).
Cells in the gate are analyzed further for percentage of APC660 positive populations using CytExpert software.
Extract genomic DNA from transduced T cells using a FastPure Cell/Tissue DNA Isolation Mini Kit according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Seed 1 × 10^4 NALM-6 cells in a U-bottom 96-well plate five days after electroporation of T cells.
Co-culture CAR-T cells with the NALM-6 cells in fresh RPMI-1640 complete medium to a total volume of 200 μL at a 10:1 E/T ratio for 24–48 hours.
For a control group, co-culture untransduced T cells with NALM-6 cells.
Twenty minutes before analysis, add 2 μL of 10% Triton-X100 per 100 μL to control wells for maximum LDH release.
Centrifuge the cell in the 1.5 mL Eppendorf tube at 500 × g for 10 min to precipitate cells and collect medium supernatant.
Dilute 1 μL of medium supernatant at 1:100 with LDH storage buffer for the LDH release assay.
Transfer 50 μL of diluted sample into a 96-well opaque-walled, nontransparent assay plate.
Add 50 μL of LDH detection reagent to each well.
Incubate at room temperature (∼25°C) for 60 min in a shaker.
Measure luminescence with a Synergy™ H1 microplate reader (BioTek).
Aspirate 90 μL of medium supernatant for detecting IFN-γ and TNF-α release.
Perform an enzyme-linked immunosorbent assay to detect cytokine release by CAR-T cells according to the manufacturer’s instructions.
Measure absorbances at 450 and 570 nm with a Synergy™ H1 microplate reader (BioTek).
Analyze data with A450nm − A570nm.
Calculate cytokine concentrations using the standard curves.
